fixed.base: NFIShortATRGated, old long native exits; short 2x1hATR/2R,1% cap and BTC4h bear gate

variants.control: feature pipeline only, must match239.2557402616% and exact prior trades
variants.half_long: uniform .5 long initial margin, shorts unchanged
variants.long_budget: 1% fee-aware long sizing using hypothetical 2x1hATR stop but no actual long hard stop
variants.long_stop: 2x closed1hATR long hard stop (min1% price), original stake ceilings and native profit exits
variants.portfolio: long_atr plus aggregate remaining-position entry-anchor planned stop loss <=3% wallet at new-entry checks; sum both sides without hedge offsets
variants.cooldown: portfolio plus same-pair long-stop cooldown1h and >=2 long stops anywhere in past1h block new longs for remainder of1h
variants.shock: block new longs if BTC last15m log return <-1.5x closed1hATR/price within past1h; existing trades unchanged
variants.volatility: half new long margin only when BTC1h return negative and BTC1h realized volatility >2x previous7d median excluding latest1h
variants.correlation: reject entry if >=2 existing same-side trades have >=.75 correlation over last7d closed1h returns; >=120 observations otherwise conservative correlation1
variants.side_cap: reject third same-side position independent of correlation

risk_definitions: 1% individual and3% aggregate are entry-time planned risks, not guaranteed realized loss limits
Partial reductions lower remaining exposure; realized partial profits do not offset remaining risk
Unknown open/pending risk blocks new portfolio allocations; only actual open pending Trades reserve budget
No forced mid-campaign reset of portfolio limit following wallet losses
Correlation is an entry neighborhood rule, not a transitive cluster guarantee
All data previously inspected; not OOS
